Tissue-Description: The protective, white, tubular sheath that emerges from the embryo and grows upwards toward the surface
The crown area where the seminal roots, adventitious roots, and the shoot meet
The first primary root that emerges from the seed to grow downward

The largest part of the wheat grain, serving as the primary food store. It consists of a protein matrix and starch granules that provide the energy necessary for the seedling to grow before it can perform photosynthesis
